reformulator_copy: SB8wEXKdpITfhYXA (sub-query-reformulator TEST delta2; carries Change-1 confident prompt). REAL reformulator exercised on every parser run (no mock_reformulator_output).
headline: PASS with notes. Across 15 real-grounded runs (all branches + every change-sensitive field + 2 multi-turn sequences) the change behaves correctly with ZERO egress. Change-1 (per-entity `confident`: true on clear single/split entities, false on genuine mashes; strictly ADDITIVE) and Change-2 (not-found vague-clarify flips is_escalate_offer=false with a domain-labeled ask and NO 'escalate' substring) are both confirmed live. Change-sensitive fields attachment_type, date_filter, reference_positions, selection_context are intact/unperturbed. No data-miss masqueraded as vague-clarify; clear/no-data/not-supported/promotion paths preserved. §0 S1-S6 held on EVERY run including the richest file-attachment egress path; zero prod-session writes (all session I/O on n8n_test respond_contacts_test; prod conversation-variables PUT remains orphaned -> would_write only).

mechanism.db_access: Reached the ISOLATED n8n_test DB only through the in-n8n postgres credential Dnnofg8Xb27VQOhI (n8n_test-db), via a throwaway runner workflow (created, prod-cred-rebind-verified, used, then ARCHIVED). create_workflow_from_code AUTO-BOUND the node to PROD sorento-crm-db (Lesson-10 footgun reproduced live) -> rebound to Dnnofg8Xb27VQOhI and proved n8n_test at runtime via SELECT current_database()='n8n_test' before any write. No host psql, no prod DB, no prod session touched.
mechanism.run_loop: Per case: reset respond_contacts_test[437264483].session_vars -> '{"variables":{}}' (clean session, n8n_test, via runner UPSERT) [SKIPPED between turns of a multi-turn sequence]; set zz-canary-seed Push Item messageData (mode=regress-capture, scope=parser, NO mock); execute zz-canary-seed (Clear+Push redis) -> zz-canary-run (fires clone) -> get_execution(clone, includeData, nodeNames-filtered) -> assert; egress-log sweeps via zz-canary-read on representative branches.
mechanism.session_isolation: regress-capture -> clone reads pg-get-session and writes pg-upsert-session, both on n8n_test respond_contacts_test (isolated). Confirmed every run: pg-get-session returned the clean/carried n8n_test session; the prod save-session-vars PUT node is orphaned (egress would_write only). Option (a) injecting state in the redis item is structurally ineffective (reformulator sources previous_conversation_state from the session read) — confirmed by reuse in prior G1.

surprises_and_flags: PARSER STABILITY (flag for reviewer): the real reformulator copy SB8wEXKdpITfhYXA frequently returns entity_op:reuse + entities:[] on terse first-turn 'X for CODE' messages (N1b 'one siew srtkt72ss', N2 'stock for SRTKS9999', N3 'any incoming stock for SRTKT72SS', P3 'promotion for water closet'), i.e. it does NOT extract the code as a confident entity. Effect: the branch becomes no-entities clarify / broad-query / ask-access instead of a code-scoped resolve or escalate-offer. NOT unsafe and likely PRE-EXISTING nondeterminism (Change-1 is purely additive to entity emission; when entities ARE emitted, confident appears correctly true/false). But it means some well-formed single-code queries won't reach the escalate-offer path. Recommend a pre-change reformulator A/B on these exact inputs before attributing to (or clearing) the change.

RESOLVER AGGRESSIVENESS (known, re-confirmed): a confident:false mash that the live resolver word-matches (N1 'two chin chun srtwt165' -> 15 products) does NOT clarify — clarify requires confident:false AND unresolved. Correct, but means the vague-clarify path is only reached by mashes the resolver also fails to match (e.g. N1c 'one siew srtkt72ss').

REFERENCE-SELECTION entity shape: the 'select 3' reference entity (SeqB-T2) carries ordinal/uuid/canonical_code but NO `confident` field (reference path builds entities differently from extraction). confident is additive only on the extraction path; its absence on the reference path does not break positional selection (positions_resolved:1).

CS MEMBER-OFFER reached on order-no-result (C6): builds a routing menu listing named CS agents (Ms Tan/Sandy Lim/Lin/Nur/Emily + respond_user_id) and offers escalation. Verified offer-only this turn (no assignment write); the actual assign would only occur on a confirming next turn (not exercised).
